newsitem.title: UK: NWE VGO PRICES FIRM ON STRONG US PRODUCTS, DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: NWE VGO PRICES FIRM ON STRONG US PRODUCTS, DEMAND.

text.p: European vacuum gas oil prices rose mid-week on the back of stronger U.S. product prices and continued demand from the United States, Europe and the Mediterranean, traders said.
They said that the net back from selling low sulphur VGO into the United States was in the high $130s.
"VGO prices are generally stronger following better product prices in the United States and there is some local demand in Europe," a trader with a major said.
Traders said the Germans ware also buying low sulphur VGO and there was demand into Israel. There was also demand into Augusta for high sulphur material.
One major will be offering 20,000 tonnes of low sulphur VGO at $140 fob and a similar sized cargo of high sulphur material at about $131/$132 fob for second half August.
